label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of _____, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verse: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
note: Cloud by day, fire by night — Israel's guide through the desert came with its own night-light.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the _____ that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verse: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
note: Solomon lectured on everything from the mighty cedar to the humble hyssop growing out of a wall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I made a _____ with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verse: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
note: Job's defense of his integrity starts with a deal he made with his own eyes.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour _____ one another;
verse: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
note: 'In honour preferring one another' — Paul's idea of competition: outdo each other in showing respect.
